given: a warehouse team member is on the stock filing form, which offers inputs for SKU, location, quantity, and the combined tracking code (inventory_code)
when: they enter a SKU, a location, a quantity, and a tracking code for a (sku, location) pair that has no existing record, and save
then: the record is filed and they land on a confirmation that shows the saved SKU, location, quantity, and tracking code
architectural_notes: E2E: exercises the full write path from the React SPA filing form (client/) through the JSON boundary (app/routes/) -> service (create-or-update on the (sku, location) key) -> repository (the only ORM layer) -> stock_records, then the confirmation view echoes the persisted SKU/location/quantity/inventory_code. Cross-cutting: input validation is owned at the boundary (field-named messages, R5/preference); the confirmation is rendered client-side by the SPA off the boundary's JSON response, never server-rendered HTML. Realizes the inward-only dependency direction and the no-full-page-reload SPA contract (R5); verified as a real integration test against the paired Lakebase branch.
